name: PhaseRetrievalPaganin
label: Phase Retrieval (Paganin)
description: Single-distance phase retrieval (Paganin et al., J. Microsc. 206, 33, 2002) for propagation-based phase-contrast projections of one material. It removes the bright and dark fringes at edges and raises the contrast of weakly absorbing samples. Apply it after flat/dark correction and before reconstruction; the result is the projected attenuation (line integrals) unless that option is off.

parameters.name: input_type
parameters.label: Input
parameters.description: Flat- and dark-corrected transmission (I/I0, about 1 in air), or line integrals (-ln of it).

parameters.name: pixel_size
parameters.label: Pixel Size (um)
parameters.description: Effective pixel size at the sample, in micrometres.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.label: Propagation Distance (m)
parameters.description: Sample to detector distance, in metres.

parameters.name: delta_beta
parameters.label: delta / beta
parameters.description: Ratio of the real to the imaginary refractive index decrement of the material. Larger values smooth more; a few hundred to a few thousand for light materials at hard X-ray energies.

parameters.name: line_integrals
parameters.label: Output Line Integrals (-ln)
parameters.description: Output the projected attenuation, which reconstruction expects. Off: the filtered transmission.
